findings.description: syncOutbox without custom executor defaulted success=true and immediately called clearSyncedOfflineMutations, permanently dropping unsynced doctor mutations without sending them to the gateway.
findings.resolution: Fixed: wired syncOutbox to delegate to OfflineSyncService.getInstance().drainOutbox() when executor is omitted, ensuring seamless batch push to /api/sync/gateway.

findings.description: ClinicControlPill displayed hardcoded '0 в очереди' in both header capsule title and popover, and handleManualSync merely pinged /api/health without draining pending offline mutations.
findings.resolution: Fixed: connected ClinicControlPill to useOfflineStore reactive metrics, live pendingMutationCount, and real drainOutbox via syncOutbox with latency calibration.

findings.description: Cross-branch event leakage: chair status, assistant CITO emergency calls, and cashier invoices lacked branchId filtering, allowing alerts from Branch 2 to spill into Branch 1.
findings.resolution: Fixed: added branchId to LanP2PDispatcherConfig, LanP2PDispatcherStatus, lanP2PMessageSchema, WebSocket ClientConn, and broadcastToOrganization; filtered out mismatched branch messages.

findings.description: Loud indicator text in header strip risked clinician distraction.
findings.resolution: Fixed: verified and hardened compact mode enforcing 8px subtle status dot and accessible aria-label without bulky text ovals.
